name: The pyramids of Giza and the Sphinx

archives.title: Giza, Pyramids, Pictures, 1883-1885, photo 24 of 27 - Archivio fotografico Museo Egizio, Turin - Museo di antropologia UniTo MAFM 0242
archives.description: Pyramids of Giza seen from the other side of the riverbank, where some Egyptians are posing with their camels. In the bottom right-hand corner, the signature of the author Bonfils is visible, written in reverse.

archives.title: Giza, Pyramids, Pictures, 1883-1885, photo 3 of 27 - Archivio fotografico Museo Egizio, Turin INV01 005
archives.description: The photograph depicts two Egyptians in the foreground sitting on some large boulders, possibly fragments from antiquity, in front of the Mena House Hotel, which had already been extended with its upper floors and dates the photograph to after 1883. In the background the pyramids of Khufu (centre) and Khafre (right) are visible. The author's signature can be seen at the bottom left.

archives.title: Giza, Pyramids, Pictures, 1870-1880, photo 1 of 27 - Archivio fotografico Museo Egizio, Turin INV01 003
archives.description: Photograph of the pyramids of Khafre (right) and Menkaure (left), pharaohs of the 4th dynasty. In the foreground, some local inhabitants are resting. The author's signature can be found at the bottom right.

archives.title: Giza, Pyramids, Pictures, 1870, photo 17 of 27 - Archivio fotografico Museo Egizio, Turin Album1 001
archives.description: The photograph shows a partial view of the Giza Plateau, with the profile of the Sphinx (still to be cleared of sand) and the pyramid of Pharaoh Khufu.

archives.title: Giza, Pyramids, Pictures, 1870-1888, photo 16 of 27 - Archivio fotografico Museo Egizio, Turin INV36 001
archives.description: The photograph shows an overview of the monuments in the Giza Plateau, in particular the Pyramid of Khufu with satellite pyramids (in the background), the Valley Temple of Khafre (in the foreground) where part of the pyramid can also be seen on the left, and behind it is the Sphinx . The author's signature is clearly visible at the bottom left.

archives.title: Great Sphinx of Giza in 3-4 profile - DPLA
archives.description: "238. Caire. Le Sphinx. L Fiorillo, Phot." albumen prints Image No. 45. "Plate No. 238. Caire. Le Sphinx. L Fiorillo, Phot." Titled in plate. Shows people and camel. 5 1/2 x 4 photo, mounted. c. 1875. Great Sphinx of Giza in 3/4 profile, with top of pyramids visible in background. A camel & 4 men are standing near the base of the sculpture. The forelegs of the Sphinx appear to be buried in the sand. Legacy file ID changed to match file names with extension on 2021-07-01. Original ID was: Wolff_AsiaAfricaEurope_singles_045.jpg
